In detail

The south-eastern centre and the hills above it: Piazza Santo Stefano, Strada Maggiore, via Castiglione and the Giardini Margherita, and the most expensive address in Bologna. What local sources do document here is property crime rather than anything directed at people — smash-and-grab raids on shops along via Santo Stefano, and burglaries of houses on the hills, which is what the Comune's neighbourhood-watch pact with the Comicolli association (valid to 31 December 2026) was set up to address. Neither is a reason for a visitor to avoid the area at any hour.
